title: How CRISPR edits a gene
subtitle: Guide, cut, repair
objective: Order the steps of a gene-editing experiment with CRISPR-Cas9.
objective_es: Ordena los pasos de un experimento de edición genética con CRISPR-Cas9.
description: CRISPR editing follows a short recipe: design a guide, give the scissors to the cell, cut, and let the cell repair the cut.
description_es: La edición con CRISPR sigue una receta corta: diseñar una guía, dar las tijeras a la célula, cortar y dejar que la célula repare el corte.

organism.description: A cell whose gene is changed on purpose.
organism.description_es: Una célula a la que se cambia un gen a propósito.

exploration.label: The tool
exploration.title: A protein and a guide
exploration.description: CRISPR-Cas9 has two parts: the protein Cas9, which cuts, and a guide RNA, which says where.
exploration.description_es: CRISPR-Cas9 tiene dos partes: la proteína Cas9, que corta, y un ARN guía, que dice dónde.

exploration.label: Repair
exploration.title: The cell does the editing
exploration.description: Cas9 only cuts. The cell repairs the break, and the repair often leaves a small change in the gene.
exploration.description_es: Cas9 solo corta. La célula repara la rotura y la reparación suele dejar un pequeño cambio en el gen.

steps.label: Design a guide RNA for the gene
steps.label_es: Diseñar un ARN guía para el gen
steps.description: The guide must match the target and sit next to a PAM.
steps.description_es: La guía debe coincidir con la diana y estar junto a un PAM.
steps.needs: Nothing: it is where it starts.
steps.needs_es: Nada: es el punto de partida.

steps.label: Combine the guide with Cas9
steps.description: Together they form the scissors with an address.
steps.description_es: Juntas forman unas tijeras con dirección.
steps.needs: The guide has to be designed first.
steps.needs_es: Primero hay que diseñar la guía.

steps.label: Deliver them into the cell
steps.needs: The scissors have to be ready.
steps.needs_es: Las tijeras tienen que estar listas.

steps.label: The guide pairs with the target DNA
steps.label_es: La guía se une al ADN diana
steps.description: The match and the PAM tell Cas9 where to cut.
steps.description_es: La coincidencia y el PAM le dicen a Cas9 dónde cortar.
steps.needs: The scissors have to be inside the cell.
steps.needs_es: Las tijeras tienen que estar dentro de la célula.

steps.label: Cas9 cuts both strands of the DNA
steps.label_es: Cas9 corta las dos hebras del ADN
steps.description: The gene is broken at the chosen place.
steps.description_es: El gen se rompe en el sitio elegido.
steps.needs: The guide has to have found its target.
steps.needs_es: La guía tiene que haber encontrado su diana.

steps.label: The cell repairs the cut, and the gene changes
steps.label_es: La célula repara el corte y el gen cambia
steps.description: The repair often adds or removes a few letters.
steps.description_es: La reparación suele añadir o quitar algunas letras.
steps.needs: There must be a cut to repair.
steps.needs_es: Tiene que haber un corte que reparar.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: Cas9 cannot cut before it has an address, and the cell cannot repair before there is a cut.
hints.content_es: Cas9 no puede cortar antes de tener una dirección, y la célula no puede reparar antes de que haya un corte.

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: Design the guide, join it to Cas9, deliver, find the target, cut and repair.
hints.content_es: Diseñar la guía, unirla a Cas9, introducirla, encontrar la diana, cortar y reparar.

hints.title: Solution
hints.content: Design → combine → deliver → find → cut → repair.
hints.content_es: Diseñar → combinar → introducir → encontrar → cortar → reparar.

completion.title: A gene, edited
completion.summary: You followed an editing experiment from the guide to the repaired gene.
completion.summary_es: Has seguido un experimento de edición desde la guía hasta el gen reparado.
completion.realWorldImpact: Because the guide is just a short RNA, scientists can aim CRISPR at almost any gene in a few days.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: Como la guía es solo un ARN corto, los científicos pueden dirigir CRISPR a casi cualquier gen en pocos días.

science.realWorldCase: In 2012 Jennifer Doudna and Emmanuelle Charpentier showed how to program Cas9 with a guide. They shared the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
science.realWorldCase_es: En 2012 Jennifer Doudna y Emmanuelle Charpentier mostraron cómo programar Cas9 con una guía. Compartieron el Premio Nobel de Química de 2020.
science.scientificContext: The cut is repaired either by joining the ends, which usually leaves small insertions or deletions that disable the gene, or by copying a template, which allows precise changes.
science.scientificContext_es: El corte se repara uniendo los extremos, lo que suele dejar pequeñas inserciones o deleciones que inactivan el gen, o copiando una plantilla, lo que permite cambios precisos.
gameplaySimplifications: Delivery into cells is a whole field of its own and is shown as one step.
gameplaySimplifications_es: La entrada en las células es un campo entero por sí mismo y aquí es un solo paso.

references.title: A programmable dual-RNA–guided DNA endonuclease in adaptive bacterial immunity
